title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: Spyglass has officially moved out of beta and is now fully available, offering robust capabilities to empower your success.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: Gain powerful new control over your content with the ability to easily upload, download, and manage files directly within the editor, giving you full command over their appearance.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap!
summary: Explore our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into our past achievements, current initiatives, and future plans.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click and drag, and seamlessly integrated them into our modern user interface for a smoother experience.

title: Seamless Live Collaboration
summary: Our latest enhancements empower teams to work together more smoothly and intuitively within the editor, making shared projects effortless.

title: Seamless Collaboration and Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've launched enhancements that make it easier to discover and collaborate on shared items with your connections, seamlessly integrating teamwork into your workflow.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko is now open source, providing our community with enhanced control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in its ongoing development.

title: Worldwide Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for international users worldwide.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning New Themes
summary: We're launching a collection of vibrant new themes and enhancing existing ones, empowering you to personalize your workspace with beautiful, high-contrast designs.

title: Powerful Knowledge Exploration
summary: Experience a more powerful Constellation view that helps you intuitively filter and share your knowledge to unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflows.

title: Powerful Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your most relevant information with our powerful new search filters, enabling you to save custom collections of your knowledge for quick access and deeper insights.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Gain instant clarity and deeper context for your interconnected ideas through dynamic content previews and customizable display modes.

title: Noeko's Official Launch: Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans
summary: Prepare to elevate your productivity as Noeko officially launches, bringing powerful self-hosting capabilities and flexible paid plans designed to perfectly fit your team's unique needs.

title: Smarter Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your welcome messages always greet you accurately based on the time of day, making your experience more personalized and precise.

title: Streamlined Tag Management & Bulk Actions
summary: Boost your productivity with new bulk actions, enabling quick removal of tags and efficient management of your ideas, quests, and sources directly from any tag list.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Now you can effortlessly bring in and interact with a wider variety of content, from YouTube videos to websites and text files, to enrich your insights and streamline your workflow.
